Layout System Demos

Demos for <lay-out>. Every page here is build output — edit src/pages/*.html or src/demo.js, then run npm run build:demo.

Layouts

The layout tokens themselves — one demo per pattern, generated from layouts/*.json.

  1. Columns
    Equal-width columns, 1–6
  2. Ratios
    9 proportional splits — columns at uneven widths
  3. Asymmetrical
    6 sidebar/content splits
  4. Autofit
    auto(fit) and auto(fill)
  5. Grid
    19 mixed-size grid patterns
  6. Bento
    10 dashboard-style box layouts
  7. Mosaic
    5 patterns, including hex
  8. Lanes
    Masonry via display: grid-lanes
  9. Stack
    Overlapping layers in one cell

Modifiers

Attributes that change how a layout behaves, on top of any layout token.

  1. Overflow
    Horizontal scroller — preview, snap, fade, center/frame
  2. Carousel
    media= controls: dots, arrows, paging, autoplay
  3. Spacing
    Breakpoint padding, margin and gap tokens
  4. Widths
    width= max-width tokens
  5. Bleed
    Escaping the page column, full-bleed bands
  6. Gap decorations
    Rules drawn in the grid gaps

Motion

Scroll-driven animation. The engine lives in @browser.style/base; load it alongside layout.css.

  1. Animate
    animate= — the children animate, staggered
  2. Animate-self
    animate-self= — the container animates
  3. Reveal
    clip-path reveals on scroll entry
  4. Reveal stack
    stack(reveal) — sticky, layered scroll scenes

Extras

  1. Icons
    SVG preview glyph for every layout variant
